description: This file defines the LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping class, which extends Symfony's ParameterBag to handle LDAP employee attribute mappings, conversions to array, extraction of attribute values from LDAP entries, and creation of mapping instances from arrays. It is part of the LDAP plugin in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping
classes.description: Handles LDAP employee attribute mappings, providing methods for manipulating, converting, and extracting LDAP attributes.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all LDAP attribute mappings as an array.

methods.name: getAllAttributeNames
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute names from the LDAP attribute mappings.

methods.name: extractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Extracts LDAP attribute values from an LDAP entry and populates an LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams object accordingly.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping from an array of field-attribute mappings, validating input.
